basis: US national-average installed unit costs (material + labor + equipment incl. the installing subcontractor's O&P, like RSMeans 'Total incl. O&P'), Q4 2025 dollars, location index 1.00, then moved to Hattiesburg, MS with the location factor below. Shared items use the same basis as the parent demo's data/unit_costs.json (Linbeck Q3 2025 forecast, RSMeans-typical magnitudes, 2025 steel/aluminum tariffs). Items marked 'Estimated' are budget figures from comparable RSMeans line items or vendor ranges, not quotes. Excludes GC general conditions, fee, contingency and escalation (added as markups).

location_factor.note: Typical RSMeans city cost index for zip prefix 394 (labor-driven), as in the parent demo; confirm against the current annual CCI table.

markups.note: General conditions 8-10% for a ~2.5-year hospital job; bonds & builder's risk 1.5-2.5%; GC fee 4-6%; 10% design contingency at schematic level (AACE / ASTM E2516 practice); escalation 4%/yr from Q4 2025 prices to the construction midpoint.
